BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LeftTutorInt:
Buhahaha!
You couldn't tell it from looking now, but I used to be one tough TRAINER.
I had a reputation as the toughest BEAUTY around, I tell you!
… … … … … …
What is it now? You don't believe me.
I'm not like that blowhard woman over there. I'm actually talented!
Let me prove it to you. I can teach your POKéMON special and yet cute moves.
But my lessons don't come free. How about paying for the moves I teach with a wee bit of Battle Points?
BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LeftTutorWel:
Buhahaha!
Are you back to learn special and yet cute POKéMON moves?
BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_TeachWhichMo: Fine, fine, look here! Which move should I teach?
BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_MoveWillBeXB: The move {STR_VAR_1}, is it? That will be {STR_VAR_2} Battle Points, okay?
BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_TeachMoveToW: Fine, fine, now pick the POKéMON I should teach the move to.
BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_HaventGotEno: What the… You haven't got enough Battle Points!
BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_IllTakeBattl: Do you see how skilled I am now? I'll take your Battle Points, thanks!
BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_YouDontWantT:
What's that? You don't want to…
If you want to see how skilled I am, you come see me anytime!
BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_RightTutorIn:
Ihihihi!
I know it's hard to see now, but I used to be one fantastic TRAINER.
I had a reputation as the most invincible SWIMMER around, I tell you!
… … … … … …
What's wrong? You don't believe me.
I'm not like that buffoonish woman over there. I'm actually experienced!
I can prove it to you. I can teach your POKéMON hard and yet pretty moves.
But my lessons don't come free. How about paying for the moves I teach with a wee bit of Battle Points?
BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_RightTutorWe:
Ihihihi!
Have you come to learn hard and yet pretty POKéMON moves?
BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_ThinkLadiesD:
Those ladies, the way they bad-mouth each other, you probably think that they don't get along.
But if that were true, they wouldn't stay out here together, would they?
BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LadiesWereSt:
When I was just a wee YOUNGSTER, those ladies were strong and beautiful.
They were idols among us TRAINERS.
Even now, age hasn't dulled their abilities.
In fact, their POKéMON moves have grown even more polished.
But… For some reason, I can't help but feel this…
Time is so cruel…
